text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D10","page":1,"quote":"-0.009"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"-0.025"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"2) # HARD CHROME PLATING 20 TO 30 MICRONS, HARDNESS 850 TO 1000 HV."}],"comment":"The g6 shaft section (F11, defined by D10 and D11) has a tolerance band of 0.016 mm, yet the drawing applies 20–30 µm hard chrome plating without adjusting the pre-plate dimensions to allow for coating thickness. The plated shaft will be oversize and will not achieve the intended g6 fit; the designer must reduce the pre-plate diameter by twice the plating thickness or specify grinding to final size after plating with explicit pre-plate limits.","recommended_correction":"Specify pre-plating undersize dimensions that account for the 20–30 µm plating thickness so the finished diameter meets the g6 tolerance band, or add a note defining the post-plate grind-to-size requirement with pre-plate limits."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"NOTE :- 1) $ TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 40-45 HRC."}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies heat treatment and hardness but does not state at which manufacturing stage it is to be applied (e.g., before or after rough machining, before plating). Without a defined sequence the shop cannot plan operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or ineffective plating adhesion.","recommended_correction":"Add the process stage to the heat-treatment callout in N1, for example 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 40-45 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL GRINDING/PLATING'."}]}
